newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-AJAX WINGER OVERMARS SIGNED BY ARSENAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX WINGER OVERMARS SIGNED BY ARSENAL.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam winger Marc Overmars signed for Arsenal on Tuesday for a reported fee of five million pounds ($8.2 million) as Arsene Wenger, manager of the premier league club, continued his buying spree ahead of next season.
Overmars was paraded in front of the press at Highbury along with another new signing, 19-year-old Portuguese striker Luis Boamorte who cost a further 1.75 million pounds ($2.9 million).
Wenger has also recently signed Frenchmen Emmanuel Petit and Gilles Grimaldi, both aged 26, as he attempts to build a younger side in Arsenal's challenge for honours in the forthcoming season.
Overmars, 24, who played 164 matches for Ajax over five years, scoring 43 goals, will become the second Dutch international at Arsenal, joining striker Dennis Bergkamp.
"Marc is a player of class," said Wenger. "He has qualities that are difficult to find in Europe. He is a good dribbler and he is not afraid to go into space.
"We neeed this type of player in our squad. Last year we lost the championship at home and this year we need more speed, more power and more penetration at home."
Overmars said: "English football is a litle bit different, you get more space and a little more freedom. And I think that with my speed and quality I can use that space very well.
"I have spoken to Dennis Bergkamp about the club and he says nothing but good things. I am very happy to be here."
